main_measure.name: t of slope of pooled 26-bar forward excess return (minus coin drift) on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 non-overlapping cases

decided_by: t = 1.52 lies between -2 and 2 on 576 non-overlapping cases.
reading: Ordinary least squares with an intercept, pooled over all coins, on every grid bar with a 26-bar return inside its window (bars with forecast 0 included); drift is the coin's mean of these grid returns over all windows.
